title: Bureaucratic Header Comments (The Redundant Prolog)
pattern: Fixed-format header comment blocks detailing author name, creation date, modification history, and other metadata at the file or routine level.
why_bad: Duplicates metadata that is automatically and more accurately tracked by modern Version Control Systems (VCS). They are high-maintenance and frequently rot.
detection: Header blocks matching standard templates with metadata keys like 'Author', 'Date', or 'Modification History'.
counterexample: Standard open-source license headers or copyright notices required by legal compliance.
fix: Delete the entire metadata header comment block.
source: Steve McConnell, *Code Complete* (2004), Chapter 32 ("Self-Documenting Code"), p. 203.
